Nope, you dont need to pay interest. E.g. if you make purchases using a credit card and pay in full every month you'll earn a top quality credit score without ever paying a dime of interest.

You can also qualify for a good credit status based on the amount of money you move, or the amount of assets under your control.

For example, in retail trade, wholesale credit availability is often based on the number of square feet of retail floor space you control, and that can be further increased to accommodate volume should you have a history of moving a large amount of goods.

In fact, if you control enough assets, you can have a good credit score even with a bad credit history.

The market for selling credit is very competitive these days.
